company.name: Finllect
company.shortDescription: Finllect is a fintech platform focused on helping Gen Z & underserved consumers build financial literacy, improve credit access.
company.description: Finllect is a financial wellness and credit-building platform designed to empower the next generation of consumers with smarter financial tools and accessible credit opportunities. The company leverages open banking technology, behavioral insights, and alternative financial data to create a fairer and more inclusive credit scoring system, especially for users with limited or no traditional credit history. Its platform offers educational content, budgeting resources, rewards, cashback features, and a credit-building debit card that helps users strengthen their financial profiles without relying on conventional banking barriers. Finllect’s mission is to improve economic mobility by making credit more accessible, transparent, and personalized for young adults and underserved communities across the MENA region.
